name: Ambience Healthcare
description: Ambience Healthcare (formerly Ambience AI) provides enterprise-grade ambient AI documentation and clinical automation for health systems. Their AutoScribe platform captures patient conversations and generates comprehensive clinical notes, while their broader platform includes pre-visit summaries, care gap identification, and clinical decision support.

pricing.estimated_range: $200-400 per provider per month (enterprise volume pricing)

free_trial.notes: Pilot programs available for health systems (typically 3-6 months)

pricing.notes: Enterprise pricing only. Implementation fees typical. Multi-year contracts with volume discounts.

ambient_ai.description: AutoScribe captures conversations and generates comprehensive clinical documentation

pre_visit.description: AI-generated pre-visit summaries from chart review

care_gaps.description: Identifies care gaps and quality measure opportunities during visits

faqs.question: What makes Ambience Healthcare different from other AI scribes?
faqs.answer: Ambience goes beyond documentation to offer a comprehensive clinical AI platform including pre-visit chart summaries, care gap identification, and coding optimization. It's designed for large health systems wanting more than just ambient documentation.

faqs.question: How much does Ambience Healthcare cost?
faqs.answer: Ambience is enterprise-priced and requires a custom quote. Typical pricing ranges from $200-400 per provider per month with volume discounts. Implementation fees and multi-year contracts are standard.

faqs.question: Does Ambience Healthcare integrate with Epic?
faqs.answer: Yes, Ambience has native integration with Epic and can write documentation directly into the EHR. It also integrates with Oracle Health (Cerner), MEDITECH, and Athenahealth.

faqs.question: Is Ambience Healthcare suitable for small practices?
faqs.answer: Ambience is designed for large health systems with 100+ providers. Small practices would benefit more from solutions like Freed, Suki, or DeepScribe that are designed for individual practitioners and smaller organizations.
